announcements.headline: Conversion of Shares and Issue of Equity
announcements.insight: Following the November update on the convertible note, this filing details the conversion of shares and equity issuance. Shareholders should monitor how this affects the capital structure.

announcements.headline: Update on Convertible Note & Trading Update
announcements.insight: The update follows the September EGM results. Shareholders should monitor for further developments regarding the convertible note.

announcements.headline: Result of EGM
announcements.insight: The EGM results follow the September notice to change auditor. Shareholders should note this governance update.

announcements.headline: Change of auditor and notice of EGM
announcements.insight: Asia Strategic Holdings Limited is convening an EGM to approve a change of auditor. This follows the interim results announced in June 2026.

announcements.headline: Interim results for six months ended 31 March 2026
announcements.insight: Interim results for six months ended 31 March 2026 are published. As this is the first filing on record, it establishes a baseline for future performance tracking.
